name: Fea

attributes.attribute: context of this extract is the Christianization of old sites
pagan divinities were canonized as such
consecrated ancient sites to Christian use

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fea in this extract frames the spread of Christianity across old holy grounds. Churches were built where pagan sites had stood. Pagan gods were turned into saints. Ireland followed the same general path. Ancient places were set to Christian use. The role of the clergy sets Ireland apart from the other Celtic lands. Ireland drew a clear line between the church and the older world.

okr.objective: Fea's extract places her within the Christianization of Celtic sites.
key_results: The extract covers the building of churches on old holy grounds.
Pagan deities were canonized as saints.
Ireland followed the same consecration pattern.
Ireland's role differs from that of other Celtic lands.
